name: fullscreen_pass_from_template
description: F-3: build a fullscreen pass shader and all from Studio. Add fullscreen pass opens the Pass Editor after a node; New... writes the fragment shader for the chosen input into the project and puts its stem in the form; a syntax error written into that file is refused by the engine's preflight and shown whole under the form, which keeps what was typed; the repaired file saves and the pass appears on the canvas. Then the file is broken again, which is what a person does in their own editor: Studio notices the write and asks the engine once, and says in the panel's status line that this engine does not reload shaders (Studio launches it with --rpc) instead of marking a node it cannot know about.
